description: Voice-first AI chat interface with waveform visualization, live transcript, and call controls.

integrations: Web Audio API for microphone capture
architectureNotes: VoiceChatPage provides the full-page voice interface with orb visualization, transcript, and controls.
VoiceTranscript renders a real-time scrolling transcript with speaker labels and confidence scores.
VoiceControls provides mic, mute, and end-call controls with audio level indicators.
Wire /api/voice/stream to a WebSocket that accepts audio chunks and returns transcription + LLM response.
TTS audio should be played back through the Web Audio API — use an AudioContext for volume control.
